Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate.
  
  
Perception is an advanced AI platform designed to empower security and IT teams to operate at the speed and scale of AI while adhering to Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles. Within Perception, the Red Agents team builds autonomous, AI-powered offensive security agents that continuously emulate real-world adversaries.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Software Engineer II**
to lead design and delivery of secure, reliable, and safe agentic red teaming capabilities at enterprise scale. In this role, you will drive technical solutions for multi-agent systems that combine Generative AI, reasoning, memory, and planning with security domain expertise, all within strict safety, authorization, and scope guardrails.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product, Applied Science, Responsible AI, and internal red teams to convert emerging adversary tradecraft and industry frameworks into scalable, customer-ready agent capabilities. You will raise engineering excellence across architecture, service health, compliance, and security hygiene, mentor engineers, and help the team execute effectively through ambiguity to deliver trustworthy AI-driven security experiences for Microsoft’s customers.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with and guide internal and external stakeholders to determine and confirm customer/user requirements for a product or solution.
* Lead discussions and own the architecture for a product/solution; create proposals for architecture by testing design hypotheses and developing design specifications.
* Create a clear testing strategy to ensure product/solution quality and prevent regression in existing code.
* Identify dependencies and incorporate them into design documents for a product/solution.
* Produce extensible, maintainable, well-tested, secure, and performant code adhering to design specifications.
* Use debugging tools, tests, logs, telemetry, and other methods to verify assumptions during development before issues occur in production.
* Leverage appropriate tooling (e.g., artificial intelligence) to improve efficiency and overall quality of work output.
* Review product code and test code to ensure it meets team standards, contains correct test coverage, and is appropriate for the product/solution.
* Design, implementation, testing, rollout and running software services.
* Work in a collaborative and agile environment, with local and remote partners and team members.
* Ship your code to thousands of machines serving millions of users around the world.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Rust, Java, JavaScript, or Python

+ OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements:**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of using advanced tooling/AI to improve work efficiency.
* Experience in software development with ability to produce maintainable and well-tested code.
* Understanding of algorithms, data structures and other systems architecture factors that affect code quality, performance, and customer experience.
* Proficiency with debugging, testing, and telemetry tools.
* Experience building Generative AI or agentic systems, including LLM orchestration, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, and safety guardrails.
* Background in offensive security, red teaming, penetration testing, or adversary emulation, including familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
* Understanding of identity and authorization concepts such as least privilege, role-based access control (RBAC), delegated access, and multi-tenant isolation, especially for autonomous or AI-driven systems.

By joining our team as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will serve as a key member of our Data and AI Solutions team and partner with our customers to understand their most complex challenges and design and implement tailored solutions. You will bring your problem-solving ability, creativity, and technical expertise to help organizations put their data to work, solve critical business challenges, and drive meaningful impact. In this role, you’ll own end-to-end execution of high-impact projects while working across industries to solve complex, real-world problems.
  
  
As an FDE, you will take ownership of projects from concept through implementation, working in small teams to deliver tailored technical solutions. Your work may span designing technical architecture, working with large-scale datasets, developing custom applications, collaborating with customer executives, and contributing to team strategy.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Work directly with clients to understand their most pressing problems and design and implement data-driven solutions to address them.
* Work in small teams with minimal supervision, taking ownership of high-impact projects from planning through implementation.
* Discuss architecture with fellow engineers and establish strategy for your team.
* Wrangle massive-scale data and code custom web applications to deliver client solutions.
* Speak with client executives to share progress, gather input, and align on priorities.
* Collaborate internally with colleagues from a variety of backgrounds, including other FDEs, product teams, and strategy teams.
* Work externally with clients, often on site, to understand and tackle their priorities.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Ability to learn continuously, work independently, and make decisions with minimal direction.
* Ability to collaborate in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfort working in a constantly evolving environment with dynamic objectives and iterative work with users.
* An eagerness to creatively solve technical problems using data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.
* Interest in working with and using large-scale data to solve valuable business problems.
* Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites; travel of 25-50% is expected, though requirements vary by team and location.

**Qualifications**

* Recent graduate with up to 1 year of professional experience in engineering or technical role.
* Engineering background, preferably in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science.
* Proficiency with one or more programming languages, such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.
* Active U.S. security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain a U.S. security clearance.

For applicants located in Illinois, CrossCountry Consulting is required to include an estimate of the compensation range for this role. The following range takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to, skills, experience, education, licenses, certifications, business needs, and internal equity. An estimate of the current range is $95,000 - $125,000 per year + annual bonus + additional benefits.
